field_shadowing.description: For every sourcetype outside TA_PARSED_SOURCETYPES the dispatcher still sends the bare NetSpout fields next to the netspout_* copies. Shadowing is add-on specific (ASA, FortiGate and Palo Alto were proven; IOS showed NetSpout values in CIM fields), so each of these needs its own live check before the bare names are removed.

protocol_gaps.expected_ingestion: syslog (arista_switch_log), sFlow collector (arista_switch_sflow) and interface counters (arista_switch_ifcounter) via saved searches/scripts
protocol_gaps.netspout_gap: NetSpout's arista:* sourcetypes use different names; sFlow is a UDP protocol NetSpout does not send into this add-on.

protocol_gaps.expected_ingestion: syslog plus REST modular inputs (Catalyst Center, Cyber Vision, SD-WAN, ISE)
protocol_gaps.netspout_gap: syslog sourcetypes are testable (cisco:ios verified); modular-input sourcetypes are not.

protocol_gaps.expected_ingestion: Splunk App for Stream IPFIX template (cisco.hsl.json/xml, ipfixmap.conf); no props/inputs/sourcetypes
protocol_gaps.netspout_gap: needs an IPFIX collector (Stream forwarder). It is not a Technology Add-on: NetSpout's flow engine and the add-on were not tested together.

protocol_gaps.expected_ingestion: REST API modular inputs (audit_alarms, inventory, metrics, custom_input)
protocol_gaps.netspout_gap: NetSpout has no REST-API collector emulation; it can only POST JSON to HEC. Whether the JSON equals the Intersight API response is unverified.
same: HEC delivery of Meraki API-shaped JSON; equivalence to the TA's modular-input output is unverified.

protocol_gaps.expected_ingestion: modular inputs (Duo, Secure Endpoint, Firepower, AI Defense, ...)
protocol_gaps.netspout_gap: not emulated except where the sourcetype is a plain syslog stream (cisco:asa).

protocol_gaps.expected_ingestion: ThousandEyes streams delivered to a HEC target (test_metrics_stream, alerts_stream, event, activity_logs_stream) plus API inputs
protocol_gaps.netspout_gap: NetSpout does not emulate the ThousandEyes stream (OpenTelemetry/webhook payloads); its metric label conflicts with the add-on's event definition.

protocol_gaps.expected_ingestion: syslog CSV (pan:log routed to pan:*) plus modular inputs (Cortex XDR, data security, IoT)
protocol_gaps.netspout_gap: syslog log types are testable (pan:traffic verified); modular inputs are not.
